budget.title: Clear context before the proposal.
budget.description: A short flow to organize objective, investment, timeline and priorities. The conversation starts with direction, not assumptions.

contact.title: Let's qualify the project before the proposal.
contact.description: Fill out the initial briefing so we can understand the project type, objective, investment, timeline and features. This allows for a more precise conversation and a proposal with real direction.
contact.returnText: After submission, the next step is an objective conversation to validate scope, priority and technical path.

steps.label: Project
steps.title: What kind of digital asset does your company need to build?
steps.description: Choose the main focus. This guides technology, design and scope depth.

steps.label: Objective
steps.title: What priority should guide the delivery?
steps.description: The priority defines focus, reduces noise and guides high-impact decisions.

steps.label: Investment
steps.title: What investment range makes sense right now?
steps.description: This reference calibrates depth, pace and level of architecture.

steps.label: Timeline
steps.title: What time window needs to be considered?
steps.description: Timing helps organize urgency, complexity and phases.

steps.label: Scope
steps.title: Which features belong in the first version?
steps.description: Select the most relevant points. The analysis may reorganize priorities by phase.

steps.label: Connections
steps.title: Which integrations could be part of the project?
steps.description: Integrations affect architecture, security and technical effort.

steps.label: Contact
steps.title: Contact details and pre-diagnosis.
steps.description: The information will be validated before submission. After that, the conversation continues with a summary of the briefing.
